claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours, never repaired
claims.evidence: Report shows solar panels only; no battery is visible in any photo, so this claim cannot be matched to any pictured item.

risks.risk: Seller's claim describes a battery, but the witness only saw solar panels — possible mismatched listing, wrong text pasted, or an attempt to bundle an unseen item into the price.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual battery (model/label) being referenced, or seller confirmation of what exactly is being sold.
risks.if_unproven: Price only the solar panel(s) actually seen; exclude any value for a battery.

risks.risk: Panel wattage, voltage and current rating unknown, which drives most of the value.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the rating label on the back junction box or a datasheet/sticker shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lowest-common unbranded panel of visible size, worst-case wattage tier.

risks.risk: Number of panels actually included in the sale is unclear (one, two, or more units).
risks.proof: A single photo showing all panels laid out together with a count-confirming caption or video pan.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single panel only.

risks.risk: Cell condition (micro-cracks, hotspots, delamination) cannot be judged from glare-heavy front shots.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each cell under even, non-glare light, plus an electroluminescence or multimeter output test if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/unknown condition, assume possible hidden cell damage.

risks.risk: Age and prior usage/storage duration unknown, affecting expected lifespan.
risks.proof: Manufacture date code on label, or purchase receipt/invoice.

risks.risk: No certification or datasheet shown, so compliance/quality tier is unverifiable.
risks.proof: Photo of certification sticker or datasheet document.

proof_requests: Legible close-up of the junction box rating label (wattage, voltage, current)
Full count shot of all panels being sold laid out together
Clear, glare-free photos of each cell surface for crack/hotspot inspection
Manufacture date code or purchase receipt
Clarification/photo of the battery mentioned in the seller's message, if it is part of this sale
Any certification or datasheet document for the panel
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies solar panels, so they can be priced at worst-case (unknown wattage, unverified condition, possible single unit); the seller's battery claim does not match the photographed item and is treated as unverifiable rather than used to inflate value.
